# eufy RoboVac

Read status and send basic cleaning or docking commands to compatible Tuya-based eufy RoboVacs through Muse Home Link, with a confirmed model schema and existing local key and device ID. It uses a compatible local eufy/TinyTuya client as described in the generic Tuya skill (gadget-tuya-wifi-devices, same lot). It excludes non-Wi-Fi models (e.g. 11S) and X10/AIOT models, and never retrieves cloud keys or extracts credentials.
